review_candidates.title: Senior Manager, Commercial
review_candidates.description: About Vantage Data Centers Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. Position Overview The Senior Manager, Commercial is responsible for leading commercial management across multiple projects or a major program within the region, ensuring effective cost control, contract administration, procurement, and commercial risk management across the full project lifecycle. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role is empowered to make informed commercial decisions within defined frameworks, proactively managing risks, resolving complex issues, and driving value outcomes across a portfolio of projects. The Senior Manager is expected to anticipate challenges, influence key stakeholders, and implement solutions that balance cost, schedule, and quality, while aligning with broader business objectives. Reporting to the Director, Commercial, APAC, the role acts as a critical bridge between regional commercial strategy and on-the-ground execution. It translates strategic priorities into consistent, high-quality delivery outcomes, ensuring that governance, financial performance, and commercial best practices are upheld across projects. The Senior Manager partners closely with Project Directors, Delivery teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to drive alignment and performance, while also contributing to continuous improvement of commercial processes and capability across APAC. This role requires strong leadership presence, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-paced, and multi-project environment. Essential Job Functions Commercial and Financial Management: Lead commercial oversight across multiple projects or a major campus, ensuring alignment with budget, forecast, and financial targets. Establish and maintain robust cost control processes, including budgeting, commitments, expenditures, and forecasting. Contract & Commercial Governance: Oversee all contractual and commercial activities across project lifecycles, including procurement, contract administration, variations, and close-out. Evaluate contractual risks and obligations, ensuring compliant, commercially sound outcomes that protect the business and drive value. Process Improvement & Delivery Excellence: Drive continuous improvement in commercial processes, tools, and reporting. Identify inefficiencies and implement practical enhancements in collaboration with project delivery, legal, and functional stakeholders to improve consistency and performance. Local Market Delivery: Support and lead commercial activities across projects in the specific market, applying strong knowledge of local market conditions, regulatory requirements, and standard forms of contract. Ensure procurement and commercial strategies are tailored to optimize delivery outcomes, manage local supply chain dynamics, and mitigate market-specific risks. Commercial Risk & Business Insight: Proactively identify, assess, and manage commercial risks across the portfolio. Provide clear, data-driven insights on cost, risk, and exposure to support decision-making and maintain alignment with business objectives. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal teams, contractors, consultants, and advisors. Communicate commercial risks, opportunities, and mitigation strategies effectively to project teams and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment and informed delivery. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Engineering, or related field. 8 years’ experience in commercial / cost management within construction or mission-critical sectors. Proven experience managing multiple projects or large-scale programs. Demonstrated ability to lead teams and influence senior stakeholders. Strong expertise in cost control and financial planning. Strong expertise in contract administration, including FIDIC, NEC, or local forms of contract. Strong expertise in procurement and supply chain management. Experience in APAC markets preferred. We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations. Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community. Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values. Vantage Data Centers is an Equal Opportunity Employer Vantage Data Centers does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage Data Centers.

review_candidates.title: Resident Project Manager
review_candidates.description: At HDR, we believe construction services are about more than delivering projects. They are about ensuring quality, safety, reliability, and accountability throughout every stage of construction. As a Resident Project Manager , you will lead the delivery of HDR's Architectural and Engineering Construction Administration services for a major data centre project within the EU. More specifically leadership of construction phase coordination, commissioning support, and stakeholder management for Phase 1 of a hyperscale Data Centre Campus in Helsinki, Finland. Acting as HDR's primary site-based representative, the successful candidate will coordinate between the client, general contractor, subcontractors, utilities, commissioning teams, and design consultants to ensure successful delivery, testing, and handover of a complex mission-critical facility. This role combines construction management, technical coordination, quality assurance, commissioning support, and client-facing leadership within a fast-paced data centre environment. Key Responsibilities Construction Administration & Technical Coordination Act as HDR's lead onsite representative. Coordinate contractors, subcontractors, consultants, vendors, and project teams. Manage RFIs, technical queries, submittals, and design changes. Ensure timely resolution of technical and coordination issues. Maintain drawing registers, document control, and construction records. Conduct site inspections to verify compliance with design intent and specifications. Monitor quality of installation and contractor performance. Resolve design-related construction issues. Commissioning & Handover Support commissioning activities through IST and final handover. Coordinate design team involvement during testing and commissioning. Review O&M manuals, as-built documentation, and record drawings. Ensure all design changes are incorporated into final project documentation. Manage utility provider interfaces and infrastructure connections. Coordinate consultants, contractors, vendors, and client stakeholders. Resolve multidisciplinary interface and coordination challenges. Technical Experience Data centre, mission-critical, pharmaceutical, semiconductor, healthcare, or other highly MEP-intensive projects. Strong understanding of: Electrical, mechanical, BMS/BAS, EPMS, Telecommunications and Security systems Experience managing: RFIs, Technical submittals, Design change processes, Contractor coordination, Commissioning and integrated systems testing experience, coordinating multiple contractors and consultants. Strong meeting management and reporting capability. Experience monitoring third-party consultants/subconsultants. Client-facing experience. Qualifications Bachelor's degree, Construction Management, Building Services, Architecture, Surveying, or related discipline. 7+ years total experience. Minimum 3 years project management experience. Chartered Engineer (CEng) or working toward chartership preferred. CSCS card or local equivalent. What We Believe HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve. Our Commitment As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day. Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.
